messages:
zara_support: Escalating Orchid Labs (org: 'orchid-trial') 1 onboarding blocked. Their ingest job aborted: ~18% of docs flagged as PII by our classifier and auto-dropped, causing the pipeline to fail. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-6011
ben_cs: Is activation fully blocked or are they continuing with partial data? Any user-facing incidents?
zara_support: Fully blocked for the onboarding run. They7re worried about both activation delay and the possibility we7re dropping regulated data. They asked for a guarantee on data handling for the trial.
luis_csm: I7ll take customer comms. Proposed immediate steps: 1) Acknowledge + apologise 2) Offer temporary ingestion mode (dry-run/metadata-only) so they can finish onboarding 3) Offer a billing pause for the failed window 4) 4pm UTC bridge with eng + AE on the call 5) If >8h, propose private deployment evaluation.
emily_eng: Quick triage: new NER model deployed last week tightened PII detection thresholds; false positive rate spiked for docs with certain ICD-like tokens. Options: a) relax PII threshold for 'orchid-trial' tenant (server-side flag) b) enable metadata-only ingest to complete onboarding then re-run full ingest after fix. Hotfix to add tenant-scoped PII-mode ready to canary. ETA: canary in ~90m, full rollout ~3h if green.
billing_bot: Finance note: billing hold requests must be approved by revenue ops. Tagging @revenue_ops. Temporary credit can be pre-approved for trials up to $500.
luis_csm: Comm plan draft to PM: 1) Immediate acknowledgement and short explanation (now) 2) Short-term workarounds: i) run ingest in dry-run mode (no tokenization or storage) OR ii) add header `X-PII-Mode: allow-onboard` to relax strict drops 3) ETA for engineered fix: ~3h, hourly updates 4) Offer private deployment evaluation and dedicated onboarding lead if needed 5) Billing hold: pending finance approval.
zara_support: Adding workaround details to ticket. Ops snippet for their infra team (dry-run):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/import \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"source":"s3://bucket/path","mode":"dry-run"}'
```
Alternative to allow onboarding (server-side flag): add header `X-PII-Mode: allow-onboard`.
emily_eng: Canary rollout started for tenant-flag patch (canary job 77531). Monitoring: https://ci.redwood.com/77531. Will monitor pii.false_positive.rate and tenant.ingest-success.
deploy_bot: Canary job 77531 kicked for pii-relaxation-service.
luis_csm: Sending ack to customer and scheduling 4pm UTC bridge. Looping AE and legal for data handling note.
ben_cs: Flagging renewal_risk=ELEVATED if not resolved in 24h. Also capturing feedback: ask product to expose PII-mode in org settings.
zara_support: Will post hourly status updates here. If canary fails, we7ll prepare a short-term private deployment proposal and fast-track legal review. :pray:
